rationale.consistency: Git client helpers mirror WorktreeRemove; prShared alias, cmdutil.FlagErrorf/MutuallyExclusive, and heredoc docs follow surrounding packages.
rationale.edge_cases: Blank path, --checkout requirement, --list exclusivity, Abs normalisation, symlink/non-dir guards, existing-worktree reuse and ff-only pull scoped via RepoDir are all covered.
rationale.scope: Core feature and shared-package move are on target, but it also swaps pr checkout's localBranchExists (show-ref) for HasLocalBranch (rev-parse) in non-worktree paths and adds WorktreeCheckoutCommands beyond the ask.
rationale.readability: Clear names and comments; checkoutBranch's checkoutClient/addWorktree branching with an if/else-if chain is slightly dense but followable.
rationale.robustness: Errors propagated, worktree validated before the API creates a branch, Copy() keeps command stubs; the show-ref to rev-parse swap silently changes existing git invocations.
rationale.maintainability: Path rules and rev-parse logic live once in pr/shared; develop and WorktreeCheckoutCommands duplicate the exists/reuse decision matrix in two styles (client calls vs arg lists).
